scenario_title: HealthSignal Demonstration Scenario — Seasonal Influenza A Outbreak (Urban Tertiary Medical Node)

surveillance_timeline.description: Community USSD symptom reports and OTC antipyretic sales increase +35%.
Clinician triage logs increase in influenza-like illness cases.
7–14 day recursive aggregate forecast projects upward surge exceeding 95% upper bound.
Cumulative sum statistic crosses decision threshold h=4.0σ, generating candidate alert.
Public health analyst reviews spatial evidence and transitions alert from CANDIDATE -> APPROVED.
Emergency admissions and inpatient bed demand reach peak surge.

review_queue_action.reviewer_notes: Surge verified across pharmacy leading indicators and clinic respiratory demand. Public health advisory issued.
